title: How to Build an E-Commerce Website With AI
summary: Build a full e-commerce website with AI — product catalog, Stripe checkout, user accounts, and admin dashboard. Own your code. No Shopify fees. Database, auth, and hosting included.
body_markdown: Depends what you're optimizing for. Shopify has a large app ecosystem, pre-built themes, and a well-documented support community — if you want to launch quickly with pre-built components and a marketplace of add-ons, it's genuinely good for that. Blink is better if you want a custom store you own outright, need to avoid Shopify's transaction fees and price escalation, or want functionality that Shopify's platform doesn't natively support. The biggest advantage: you get full custom code and own every line of it, rather than renting access to a managed platform where capabilities are gated by plan tier.
